conclusion.effect_on_remaining_units: current static evidence weakens the earlier page-param +0x26 -> work +0x26 alias theory; the active work +0x26 source remains unresolved
conclusion.plain_english: The video code is almost certainly receiving the work object whose geometry is filled by JobMgr. The PrintMgr wrapper/list nodes preserve a pointer payload; they do not create the missing page-height field. The page-height value is proven in the earlier page-param block, but this chain does not show it being copied into the work object field that prepare reads.
